introduction: North Carolina WIC provides nutrition support for eligible pregnant or postpartum participants, infants and young children.
description: North Carolina WIC provides nutrition support for eligible pregnant or postpartum participants, infants and young children.

sections.who: Residency, category, income and nutrition screening apply. Medicaid, Work First or FNS participation meets the income condition.
sections.get: Benefits include healthy foods, breastfeeding support, nutrition education and referrals.
sections.docs:
• Identity for each applicant.
  • Residency evidence.
  • Income or qualifying-benefit proof.
sections.apply:
1. Find a clinic

    Use the county directory or referral form, or call844-601-6881.

  2. Arrange the visit

    The state prefers a first in-person visit; remote options may be available.

  3. Complete screening

    Discuss nutrition and provide proof.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using NC WIC applying. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Do qualifying-benefit recipients need extra income proof?
The state says no additional income documentation is needed.
Identity, address and income or qualifying benefits.
